text:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU prefill OOM spike on cluster-gamma — 18 container restarts in last 10m. Triggering pages to oncall. Affected routes: /v1/generate (model: rdx-xlarge-ctx). Approx error-rate 6% for requests with >64k tokens.

alice: oncall alice here, joining. any obvious culprit? which nodes showing restarts?

bob: i'm seeing repeated `cudaMalloc` failures during prefill on node-12 and node-14. sample log:
```
[2026-03-17T21:12:34Z] model-serving[pid=84]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (device 0)
[2026-03-17T21:12:34Z] model-serving[pid=84]: prefill size=124568 tokens, kv_cache=45GB
[2026-03-17T21:12:34Z] containerd: container exited with code 137 -> restarted by k8s
```

carol: looks like a single tenant is sending huge prompt batches (120k tokens) that blow past our expected context. prefill path doesn't trim.

elena: creating a customer impact note: tenant-123 (high-touch) seeing ~12% failed requests in last 15m, intermittent 500s. CSM looped in.

dave: customer ops notified, sent them temporary guidance to split input and use streaming -> smaller prefill windows.

alice: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply router-level quickcap to drop/redirect prefill requests above 80k tokens 2) roll hotpool restart to purge stuck KV caches 3) cordon node-12 if illegal-address/CUDA persists. executing now.

infra-bot: router hotpatch queued (patch id: rp-20260317-001). will apply to 3 regions.

alice: applying quickcap via internal API now:
```
curl -s -X POST https://router.internal/configs
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
  -d '{"drop_prefill_above":80000, "reason":"mitigate-prefill-oom-20260317"}'
```

bob: also seeing `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` on node-12 intermittently — attaching a short kernel trace: 
```
[2026-03-17T21:15:01Z] GPU0: illegal memory access at 0x7f8b2c..., backtrace -> cuLaunchKernel()
[2026-03-17T21:15:02Z] container runtime: segfault in process
```

alice: draining node-12 to stop further restarts: 
```
kubectl drain node/node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30
```

infra-bot: node-12 cordoned and drained. pods evicted to hotpool-2.

carol: post-apply checks: add server-side trimming for prefill path and histogram metrics for prefill sizes (bucketed). action: add prefix-eviction and per-request trim to 64k default.

elena: customer CSM updated tenant-123 with mitigation and ETA for permanent fix.

dave: customer response: they can throttle to 50k for now, will push a change shortly.

alice: observed effect: after router quickcap + hotpool restart, container restarts dropped to 0 in last 6m for the affected nodes. error-rate down to ~0.8% for large requests. continuing monitoring.

carol: long-term action items (to track in postmortem): [1] enforce max-prefill at edge + server-side fallback, [2] autoscale prefill-capable pool when >X 64k+ requests/min, [3] add KV-cache health metric and eviction policy, [4] improved tenant throttling docs.

alice: severity bumped to SEV2 due to partial customer impact. handing off to night oncall @sylvia for monitoring and follow-up. please pick up remediation list and coordinate with product for config lock.

sylvia: ack, i'll watch the dashboards and follow up with a short incident summary in the morning.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> ongoing monitoring. incidents runbook updated with link to quickpatch rp-20260317-001.

alice: closing active mitigation loop, leaving alerts enabled. will post final postmortem once we've collected traces and timelines. :white_check_mark:
